title: wildmat: GroupFilter unit tests (independent oracle)
description:
## What
Write a comprehensive unit test module for GroupFilter and WildmatPattern in crates/core/src/wildmat.rs, using RFC 3977 §4.1 test vectors as the independent oracle.

## Algorithm
Agent T derives expected values from RFC 3977 §4.1 and the epic acceptance criteria BEFORE reading the implementation from whss.2.

Test vectors to encode (oracle: RFC 3977 §4.1 + epic acceptance criteria):
1. comp.* matches comp.lang.rust: true
2. comp.* matches alt.test: false
3. * matches anything (including dots): true
4. alt.? matches alt.a: true; matches alt.ab: false
5. Exact bare name alt.test matches alt.test: true; matches alt.test2: false
6. Case insensitive: COMP.LANG.RUST matches comp.*: true
7. Ordered list ["comp.*", "sci.*", "!alt.binaries.*", "alt.test"]: alt.binaries.pictures → false (negation matched)
8. Same list: alt.test → true (exact positive match after negation miss)
9. Same list: comp.lang.rust → true (first positive match)
10. Same list: rec.music → false (default deny, no pattern matched)
11. All-negation ["!comp.*"]: GroupFilter::new returns Err(AllNegation)
12. GroupFilter::accepts("") → false

## Defensive programming rules
- Test module uses #[cfg(test)] 
- No test may use the code under test as its own oracle — expected values are hardcoded from RFC
- Each test has a single assertion with a descriptive name

## Agent team
Tester-only: Agent T (write tests from RFC 3977 without reading whss.2 implementation), Agent V (run tests against whss.2 implementation)

## Tests
The tests ARE the deliverable. All 12 test vectors enumerated above, each as a named #[test] function.
